title: Find the job object Claude Code gives hook processes on Windows
goal: A probe hook run under Claude Code on Windows shows whether its process is in a job object and with which limits (kill-on-close, breakaway allowed); the result is a DER fact in python/stdlib-windows-portability replacing its UNK, and the gap entry is Resolved.

gates.question: Run the probe hook (the agent writes it and gives the steps) on a Windows machine with Claude Code, and paste its output?

notes: Needs a Windows machine: work it in a Windows session of this clone. The Windows laptops with Claude Code and this clone are the machine the gate asks for.
